notes: Phase-1 core of the full audit (v1.11.48, 12 items). F2 (release blocker): flushSaves()/flushTestbook() run before every refreshDataFromServer() re-read, so a tick made <400 ms before a refresh can no longer be silently lost; saveState()/saveTestbook() keep the 400 ms debounce + serial queue, bodies stringified at send time. F1 (release blocker): one DAY_CAP_MIN = 14*60 used in all five paths — dayIssues, programme_issues (server), gapForDay, Dey builder (choice now caps at 14 h), reverse planner; the warning kind name stays the historical 'over12h' and the i18n key stays issOver12h (renaming would break pinned verify1119 checks), only the threshold and text changed to 14 hours. U1: dark danger text tokens --danger / --danger-text #e06e6e -> #e88383 (6.2:1 on card, 5.4:1 on surface-2, 5.2:1 on danger-soft; fills/borders and the light theme unchanged; --cat-overdue untouched — it is chart fill/stroke only, never text). CQ-01: dashboard 'next exam' KPI uses full-range jalaliLabel (Maz-7 on 2027-01-01 shows '11 دی 1405', not the raw ISO string); jalaliText itself unchanged. I-1: 'باقی‌مانده' is now two numbers — total remaining + still doable before the day's last box ends — in the hero and the mini-hero; once nothing is doable the day shows 'روز تمام شد'. I-8: sleep-guard warning in dayIssues when the day's latest box ends after 23:30 (01:00 is past 23:30 in study-day minutes, so one check covers both) — warning only, never a block. I-3: quality indicators that fail the adequacy gate show 'داده کافی نیست' instead of being silently dropped. P-1: dashboard progress KPI forecasts the programme end date from the dated-tick completion pace (7-day rate, 14-day fallback; '—' when the rate is 0), with days early/late vs the 27 Azar deadline and the pace in the tooltip. I-4: exam simulation overlay closes via Esc or backdrop click, opening the EXISTING exit confirm — never a silent exit. P-4: gentle next-box reminder — one silent toast 10 minutes before the next box starts (once per box per day, never for done/hidden boxes or while its timer runs; click jumps to Today + the box, action starts its timer); toggleable in Settings, default ON (state.nextBoxRemind / nextBoxReminded, server schema updated). P-7: keyboard shortcuts guide ('؟' key or the topbar '؟' button) listing Ctrl+K / Esc / ↑↓ / Enter / T / Space / ؟; T ticks the current box and Space starts/stops its timer, only when focus is not on an input/button and no modal or overlay is open. IA rename (i18n values only): tab 'گذشته' -> 'عقب‌افتادگی‌ها', tab 'تاریخچه و تحلیل' -> 'تحلیل'.
